card.name: Just before an ingredient or quantity list
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spacing right after a preparation lead-in, such as a colon after "you will need the following" or a space after a recipe item. It fires where a list of amounts or components is about to start.

modes.label: Colon before components
modes.description: A colon after a lead-in phrase introducing the ingredients or amounts needed in a compounding or dilution step.
modes.example: make an oral suspension (10 mg/mL) from 100 mg rimantadine hydrochloride tablets, you will need the following<<:>> 100 mg tablets of rim

modes.label: Between list items
modes.description: A space or comma after an item in a recipe or dosing table, just before the next count or quantity.

modes.label: Add before a volume
modes.description: The word add in dilution instructions, right before a volume to be measured.

card.writes: It raises number words and counts such as two, eight, sixteen and fifty, so a quantity is expected next.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a number of items or an amount is about to be named in a preparation or recipe list.
